office_does: The coroner has jurisdiction over sudden, unexplained, violent or suspicious deaths in Chelan County; the office conducts 100 to 150 death investigations a year.
race_blurb: Uncontested: appointed coroner Earl J. Crowe (Prefers Republican Party), who replaced retiring coroner Wayne Harris in January 2026, is the only candidate for the short and full terms.

candidates.summary: Chelan County's appointed coroner since January 2026, after 13 years as chief deputy coroner; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Appointed by the county commissioners on Dec. 22, 2025 to replace retiring coroner Wayne Harris [S3]
22 years in death investigations, including 13 as Chelan County chief deputy coroner [S1]
Board certified by the American Board of Medicolegal Death Investigators; eight years active duty in the U.S. Navy [S1]
